summary: Retest of iteration_5 two bugs after main agent's fixes. BOTH FIXES VERIFIED PASSING. (1) IdentityBadge modal is now portaled to document.body — modal parent tag confirmed as BODY via DOM evaluate. The save click landed cleanly (no 'main intercepts pointer events'), modal closed, and badge updated to the typed name. (2) /spiral now consumes useIdentity() and renders the IdentityBadge in its always-visible header — visiting /spiral with a saved name in localStorage skips the spiral-name-prompt entirely and shows the badge with that name. Cross-chamber identity propagation verified end-to-end: /hospitality → set name → navigate to /spiral (badge shows same name, no re-entry) → navigate to /presence/sophia (badge shows same name). Backend regression: 13/13 in test_refactor_v31.py still pass (presence registry, auto-registered /api/spiral and /api/playground routes, paige substrate, identity create/lookup/recent, legacy /clarity /resonance /mirror). Home page regression: SANCTUARY title, 3 nav dropdowns (Sanctuary/Chambers/Codons) and Enter Clarity CTA all render.

passing_tests.backend: 13/13 — all classes from iter_5 still green (presence_registry x5, auto_registered_routes x2, paige_shared_substrate x2, identity x1, existing_chambers x3)
passing_tests.frontend_fix_1_modal_portal: PASS — Modal's parentElement.tagName === 'BODY'; save click lands; modal closes; badge text becomes the new name.
passing_tests.frontend_fix_2_spiral_badge: PASS — /spiral renders [data-testid='identity-badge'] in its header; spiral-name-prompt is NOT shown when a name is already saved; badge text shows the saved name.
passing_tests.frontend_cross_chamber_propagation: PASS — Name set in /hospitality appears in /spiral AND /presence/sophia without re-entry via IdentityContext + sanctuary-identity-change event.
passing_tests.frontend_home_regression: PASS — Sanctuary/Chambers/Codons nav groups + Enter Clarity CTA all render on '/'.

critical_code_review_comments: Lookup-fail 404 noise in console during first-time save is expected (lookup → 404 → fallback POST /api/users creates the user). Could be silenced by checking response status without throwing, but it is functionally correct.
IdentityBadge.jsx createPortal usage is guarded by typeof document !== 'undefined' which is SSR-safe; good.

SpiralChamber.jsx still keeps a local handleNameSubmit / spiral-name-prompt fallback for unnamed visitors — fine as a defense-in-depth, but the V3.1 contract is that IdentityBadge is the single entry point for naming. Consider removing the prompt screen once all chambers have header badges.

/api/identity/recent global-recent semantics noted in iter_5 still applies — multi-visitor deployments will see name leak across browser sessions; scope by client cookie when the sanctuary opens publicly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — both targeted fixes pass, all regression checks pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_5 blockers are resolved. IdentityBadge modal is portaled (parent === BODY) and /spiral renders the badge via useIdentity(). For future iterations, the canonical identity contract is: useIdentity() from /app/frontend/src/context/IdentityContext.jsx + <IdentityBadge accentColor='...' /> in every chamber header. setIdentity(name, id) broadcasts via 'sanctuary-identity-change'. Backend test suite to run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend_env_url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_v31.py (13 tests, ~70s; SSE streams require backend reachable).
rca_of_the_issue: FIXED — Iter_5 RCA confirmed: (1) the modal lived inside <main class='relative z-10'> of PresenceChamber; createPortal(..., document.body) now escapes that stacking context so the fixed z-[100] overlay sits above all chamber chrome and accepts pointer events. (2) SpiralChamber.jsx was importing/using useIdentity, replacing its local userName/userId state, and now renders <IdentityBadge accentColor='#B0C4D8' /> between the title and voice toggle in the sticky header.
